name: sgs/icon
title: SGS Icon
description: Icon from Lucide, the brand registry, WordPress icons, Dashicons, emoji or a pasted SVG, in an optional square, circle or pill with its own border, coloured by the theme, a brand or the client; linkable, and bindable to Site Info (a blank link hides).

icon.label: Icon
icon._note: The block root: alignment and the Spacing padding and margin, which sit OUTSIDE the shape (plan D3). Every colour, border and size lives on the shape and glyph elements.

shape.label: Shape
shape._note: `.sgs-icon__shape`: the shape around the glyph. Colours print as --sgs-icon-* custom properties only when the client set them, so a wrapping sgs/social-icons group default (--sgs-si-*) and brand colours show through; style.css paints the theme roles last. A custom outline (hexagon, diamond, octagon, star, blob) paints no box: its inline svg.sgs-icon__outline draws the background as fill and the border as stroke. Width and height come from shapeSize (circle and the outlines use width only); unset, the shape is the icon size plus 2 x spacing-20 when it has a background or border.

glyph.label: Glyph
glyph._note: `.sgs-icon__svg` / `__dashicon` / `__emoji`: the glyph, sized by iconSize (--sgs-icon-size, per device).

label.label: Label
label._note: `.sgs-icon__label-text`: the optional visible label inside the link (showLabel), beside, below or above the shape (labelPosition). Its text is the link's accessible name. labelGap is the space between the shape and the label (the link's gap). Colours print as --sgs-icon-label-colour[-hover] only when set, so a wrapping sgs/social-icons group default (--sgs-si-label-colour) shows through; unset, the label takes the icon colour a client set, else the site's text colour.

brandName.description: Brand registry slug drawn when iconSource is 'brand' (includes/data/brand-registry.json).

iconSvg.description: Client-pasted inline SVG markup when iconSource is 'custom'. Sanitised client-side (sanitiseSvg()) and re-sanitised server-side (wp_kses() + sgs_svg_kses_allowed_tags(), render.php) before output — same shape the IconPicker stores for any custom-SVG source across the framework (Spec: IconPicker.js/icon-data.js, 2026-09-28).

iconSize.description: Glyph size per device {desktop,tablet,mobile}: a CSS length (px, rem, em, %) or a theme spacing preset. Unset = the wrapper's group size, else 32px.

iconFill.description: Fills a stroke glyph with the icon colour. Registry brand marks are already filled and ignore it.

iconRotate.description: Turns the shape and glyph by this many degrees (a paint-time rotate(), so the layout box keeps its size). 0 = none.

shape.description: The outline of the background and border. Only the square takes a radius; circle is 50%, pill 9999px from the stylesheet. hexagon, diamond, octagon, star and blob are custom outlines (includes/data/icon-shapes.json): an inline SVG behind the glyph whose fill is the background and whose stroke is the border, with no radius, no gradient and one size (width).

showBackground.description: Paints the shape's background. Brand colours turn it on.

shapeSize.description: Shape size per device {desktop:{width,height},…}: CSS lengths or theme spacing presets. Circle uses width only; height follows width while shapeSizeLinked. Unset = icon size + 2 x spacing-20.

colourMode.description: inherit and brand use brand colours when the icon is bound to a brand's Site Info key or draws a brand glyph; theme never does. A colour the client sets always wins.

iconColourGradient.description: Gradient painting the glyph (wins over iconColour).

backgroundColourGradient.description: Gradient painting the shape's background (wins over backgroundColour).

ariaLabel.description: The link's accessible name, or an unlinked icon's image name. Blank: the registry label for the bound Site Info key or brand glyph, else one from the link (Call, Email, the site name).

showLabel.description: Shows a visible text label inside the link, beside, below or above the icon. The label then is the link's name for screen readers. Inside an sgs/social-icons row, the row can switch it on for every icon.

labelText.description: The visible label. Blank: the accessible name (ariaLabel, else the registry label for the bound Site Info key or brand glyph, else one from the link).

labelPosition.description: Where the label sits: after the icon (end), before it (start; both follow the reading direction), below it or above it. Inside a row, an icon left on end takes the row's position.

labelGap.description: Space between the icon and its label per device {desktop,tablet,mobile}: a CSS length or a theme spacing preset. Unset = spacing-20.

labelColourGradient.description: Gradient painting the label text (wins over labelColour).

scaleHover.description: Grows the shape on hover and keyboard focus of a linked icon (1 = none). Reduced motion turns it off.

opacityHover.description: Fades the icon (or icon link) to this opacity on hover/focus (0-1; 1 = no visible change). 0 (default) disables the fade entirely, so an untouched icon is unaffected.
